description: This file defines the RunningService class, which models the execution state of a service, including start and end timestamps, its name, mode, and associated service model.

classes.name: RunningService
classes.description: Represents a running instance of a service, tracking timing information, service details, and providing equality and hashcode implementations.

methods.name: RunningService(String localName, ModelService model, int mode)
methods.description: Constructs a new RunningService instance with specified name, model, and mode, initializing start timestamp.

methods.name: getLocalName()
methods.description: Returns the local name of the service.

methods.name: getMode()
methods.description: Returns the mode of the running service.

methods.name: getStartStamp()
methods.description: Provides a clone of the start timestamp when the service started.

methods.name: getEndStamp()
methods.description: Provides a clone of the end timestamp when the service ended, if set.

methods.name: setEndStamp()
methods.description: Sets the end timestamp to the current timestamp.

methods.name: equals(Object o)
methods.description: Checks for equality based on model, mode, and start timestamp.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on object identity.
